definitions.explanation: Two people or things that go together or are matched. Used for romantic couples, matched sets, or partners in activities.

examples.japanese: ペア⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
ペアルック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: A couple in matching outfits was walking by.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ペア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦ダンス→ダンス：03856_dansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: At the competition, they pair up and perform a dance.

notes:
ペア refers to a matched pair or partnership — two people or things that go together. From English "pair."

WATCH OUT:
ペア emphasizes a matched or complementary set, not just any two items. For counting two of something, use ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ or {二個|にこ} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ペア⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a pair, to team up
- ペアルック: matching outfits (worn by couples)
- ペアリング: matching rings (for couples)
- ペアチケット: pair ticket (two-person ticket)

USAGE IN SPORTS:
- ペアスケーティング: pairs figure skating
- ダブルス / ペア: doubles (in tennis, badminton)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧: set, pair (Japanese word, used for teams/groups)
- ⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧: couple (romantic context)
- ⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧: duo, partnership (from "combination," often for comedy duos or work partners)
